description: This file defines an in-memory implementation of the NotesSyncService interface, enabling synchronization of notes with a mocked remote store. It provides methods to push notes to and pull notes from the in-memory store, simulating server behavior for testing or development purposes.

classes.name: InMemoryNotesSyncService
classes.description: A class providing an in-memory implementation of the NotesSyncService interface, facilitating note synchronization via a local HashMap acting as a fake remote store.

methods.name: pushNotes
methods.description: Saves a list of notes into the in-memory remote store, updating existing entries or adding new ones, and touches a clock to simulate server time progression.

methods.name: pullNotes
methods.description: Retrieves notes from the in-memory store that have been updated since a given timestamp.
